q: Landauer's principle states that erasure of one bit of information in a computation requires dissipating at least:
opts: kT ln 2 of heat into the environment
exp: Landauer (1961): logically irreversible operations (like bit erasure) must dissipate at least kT ln 2 ≈ 3×10⁻²¹ J at temperature T. This connects information theory and thermodynamics at a fundamental level.
